title: Study plan: Computer Science (CIP 11.0701) mapped to O*NET occupations
description: One markdown study plan from Grok-Edu-Career-Pathways: 26 linked O*NET-SOC occupations (from the CIP 2020 to O*NET-SOC 2019 crosswalk), top-8 knowledge areas and top-6 essential skills by mean O*NET importance across those occupations, and a 4-year outline (DreamCo-derived template text).
license: CC BY 4.0 (O*NET database + crosswalk); DreamCo outline unlicensed/undeclared
rights_basis: O*NET 31.0 Database and O*NET Crosswalk Files are CC BY 4.0 per onetcenter.org/database.html and onetcenter.org/crosswalks.html; DreamCo outline is DreamCo-authored template text.
AI_training_allowed_or_unknown: allowed (CC BY 4.0 places no field-of-use restriction; attribution required)
estimated_size: 2.9 KB (1 of 27 plans; 296 major-occupation links across the set)
license_risk: low; gaps are metadata (no provenance.json, no ownership_class), not rights
attribution_text: Major-to-occupation links come from the O*NET Resource Center `Education_CIP_to_ONET_SOC.xlsx` crosswalk (2020 CIP to O*NET-SOC 2019). Knowledge and skill importance values come from the O*NET 31.0 Database by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA), used under the CC BY 4.0 license. USDOL/ETA has not approved, endorsed, or tested these modifications. The 4-year outline is DreamCo-derived guidance, not O*NET data.

score_justifications.rights_clarity: Both sources verified CC BY 4.0 on onetcenter.org pages, but the asset carries no ownership_class/rights tags and the crosswalk's license is not stated in the file.
score_justifications.training_relevance: Useful grounding for career-guidance bots (major->occupation->knowledge/skills), but one short templated plan with no Q/A or task items.
score_justifications.data_quality: Links are validated against the official crosswalk by tests (2 pass), but importance values are unweighted means over 26 mixed occupations and the outline is a mechanical template (e.g. Year 4 targets the first-listed SOC, a management role; 'Customer and Personal Service' as an advanced course); no human review.
score_justifications.provenance: Sources pinned with sha256 in SOURCES.md and footer names sources, but no machine-readable provenance.json, no build commit/version, no ownership classes.
score_justifications.freshness: Built on O*NET 31.0 (current production release, Aug 2026) and the current CIP crosswalk.
score_justifications.coverage/diversity: 27 majors out of the much larger CIP 2020 six-digit program list; US-only, English-only.
score_justifications.format/usability: Clean consistent markdown plus CSV/JSON siblings, but no data dictionary or per-plan machine-readable schema.
score_justifications.benchmark_value: No evaluation items, answer keys, or held-out set; not a benchmark as built.
score_justifications.commercial_package_potential: Underlying O*NET data is free (and My Next Move/O*NET OnLine offer similar views); value depends on a DreamCo synthesis layer that is currently template-only.
score_justifications.maintenance/updateability: Deterministic build.py + fetch_sources.py with sha256 verification make rebuilds easy; URLs are hard-pinned to 31.0 and there is no refresh-diff.
